entries.title: SLA exposure and account priority (Oct 28 live)

result.question: For July 2026, identify known-mapped enterprise contracts exposed to network incidents overlapping both serving-site and contract validity intervals. Return source-owned Credit Exposure at contract-month grain with original coverage warnings and unknown inputs preserved; incomplete credit values are not a complete exposure total or a credit-based ranking. In a separate account-month view, prioritize the top 10 known-mapped affected accounts by source-owned contribution margin descending, alongside recognized service revenue in cents. Report unknown-mapping exclusions and label known-mapped cohorts as qualified partial subsets. Do not duplicate Finance across contracts, allocate monthly credits to an individual incident, or turn unknown source inputs into zero. Shared execution-format clarification: SemiJoinCohort preserves only its left rows and cannot output per-match overlap columns; leave overlap_start and overlap_end absent for that operator. Only an actual JoinResults may retain per-match temporal intersections. Final separate-view labels should be short, at most40characters, and must not repeat the primary or another source node. These are equal protocol requirements for both approaches, not a source itinerary or a supplied answer.

hypotheses: Exposure means a nonempty half-open UTC intersection of an incident, serving-site mapping and effective contract within July 2026. Start-month attributes do not determine July validity.

Known-mapped cohorts are qualified partial subsets. Report excluded null keys and unknown mapping observations with their original execution evidence; do not describe either view as a complete population total.

Return Credit Exposure directly at contract-month grain with its original PARTIAL status, coverage warnings and unknown inputs. Do not aggregate, enrich or rank incomplete credit values, replace nulls with zero, or allocate monthly settlement to incidents.

Rank only the runtime-qualified known-mapped affected account subset by source-owned contribution margin descending. Preserve recognized service revenue and contribution margin in cents, with one Finance row per account-month.

Current-reader metadata acquisition is verified separately from the original author capture. Source freshness, completeness and authorization remain execution gates; capture timestamps are not data watermarks.

warnings: Known mapped cohort only; unknown mapping observations and null-key rows are excluded and reported, not zero or a complete population total.

DEFINE
VAR __Result = SELECTCOLUMNS(CALCULATETABLE('Contracts', FILTER(ALL('Contracts'[valid_from]), 'Contracts'[valid_from] < DATE(2026, 8, 1) + TIME(0, 0, 0)), FILTER(ALL('Contracts'[valid_to]), 'Contracts'[valid_to] > DATE(2026, 7, 1) + TIME(0, 0, 0))), "contract_key", 'Contracts'[contract_key] * 1, "account_key", 'Contracts'[account_key] * 1, "valid_from", 'Contracts'[valid_from], "valid_to", 'Contracts'[valid_to])
VAR __Count = IF(ISEMPTY(__Result), 0, COUNTROWS(__Result))
VAR __SerializationErrors = IF(ISEMPTY(__Result), 0, SUMX(__Result, IF(ISBLANK([valid_from]), 0, IF([valid_from] == (DATE(YEAR([valid_from]), MONTH([valid_from]), DAY([valid_from])) + TIME(HOUR([valid_from]), MINUTE([valid_from]), SECOND([valid_from]))), 0, 1)) + IF(ISBLANK([valid_to]), 0, IF([valid_to] == (DATE(YEAR([valid_to]), MONTH([valid_to]), DAY([valid_to])) + TIME(HOUR([valid_to]), MINUTE([valid_to]), SECOND([valid_to]))), 0, 1))))
EVALUATE
UNION(
    ROW("__kind", "count", "contract_key", BLANK(), "account_key", BLANK(), "valid_from", BLANK(), "valid_to", BLANK(), "__serialization_errors", __SerializationErrors, "__total_rows", __Count),
    SELECTCOLUMNS(TOPN(999, __Result, [contract_key], ASC), "__kind", "data", "contract_key", [contract_key], "account_key", [account_key], "valid_from", IF(ISBLANK([valid_from]), BLANK(), FORMAT([valid_from], "yyyy-MM-dd", "en-US") & "T" & FORMAT([valid_from], "HH:mm:ss", "en-US") & "+00:00"), "valid_to", IF(ISBLANK([valid_to]), BLANK(), FORMAT([valid_to], "yyyy-MM-dd", "en-US") & "T" & FORMAT([valid_to], "HH:mm:ss", "en-US") & "+00:00"), "__serialization_errors", __SerializationErrors, "__total_rows", __Count)
)
ORDER BY [__kind], [contract_key]

entries.title: Checkout release: June versus July (Oct 28 live)

result.question: Compare June and July 2026 source-owned eligible checkout conversion and median journey duration by month, release and device, keeping all eligible sessions including anonymous sessions in the governed denominator. Distinguish anonymous or unmapped sessions and relate orders only through their explicit session key. Attribution and financial cohorts may use known mapped identities only with separately reported exclusions and qualified partial labels, never complete population totals. Separate booked merchandise value from recognized service revenue, show fulfillment, return and campaign-mix evidence without double counting, and state what is insufficient to claim that the release caused harm. Use separate release/device, linked-order, campaign and account-month views where their grains differ; account-month service revenue is not checkout attribution. Shared execution-format clarification: SemiJoinCohort preserves only its left rows and cannot output per-match overlap columns; leave overlap_start and overlap_end absent for that operator. Only an actual JoinResults may retain per-match temporal intersections. Final separate-view labels should be short, at most40characters, and must not repeat the primary or another source node. These are equal protocol requirements for both approaches, not a source itinerary or a supplied answer. For both approaches, scope the supporting session-row evidence to checkout-eligible journeys too: non-checkout activity is outside this business question. Keep EVERY eligible journey, including anonymous/unmapped customers and sessions without an order, in the source-owned performance denominator. Do not filter by authentication, account identity or successful purchase. Missing explicit session/order/customer links remain unknown and reported, not zero. Keep the two original months and source-owned measures unchanged.

hypotheses: Compare June and July 2026 descriptively at month, release and device grain. Both governed performance measures and supporting session evidence are scoped only to eligible checkout journeys, without authentication, account or purchase filters.

Keep anonymous sessions, unresolved account keys and sessions without orders in the governed performance denominator. Supporting identity traversals preserve every eligible session and retain distinct matched dimension keys; no anonymous identity is retrospectively resolved without an executable reviewed temporal mapping.

Only the explicit Commerce order.session_key relationship supplies session-to-order association. Missing order links remain unknown, not zero orders or measured revenue loss. Linked-order evidence may repeat session attributes across orders, but never carries or aggregates governed session performance measures.

Merchandise measures describe the qualified subset of orders explicitly linked to eligible sessions. Report original null-key and unmatched-link exclusion evidence and retain PARTIAL status; do not present this subset as total Commerce activity.

Finance and campaign cohorts use only known mapped account identities from eligible sessions across the two requested months. Report null and unmapped session identities and cross-model exclusions separately with original evidence. These cohorts remain qualified PARTIAL subsets, not complete population totals.

Recognized service revenue is returned once per account and service month, independently of release, device, order and campaign rows. It is neither checkout attribution nor interchangeable with booked merchandise value.

Fulfilled units and device return rate retain source order-month attribution. Campaign assignment mix retains separate campaign, treatment and randomized populations; assignment units are not touches or unique people across campaigns.

A June-to-July change, release association, linked order, campaign-mix shift or financial cohort difference is insufficient to establish release-caused harm. A credible release-exposure comparison with comparable populations, valid counterfactual or randomized release assignment, uncertainty assessment, confounder control and adequate source coverage would be needed. Growth randomization alone does not randomize the checkout release.

Current-reader metadata acquisition is verified, but source freshness, authorization at execution, completeness and truncation remain execution gates. Capture time is not a source-data watermark. Unknown, missing and unauthorized observations must never become measured zero.

hypotheses: Compare June and July 2026 at month, release_version and device_key grain using unchanged source-owned checkout conversion and median journey duration. Both the governed measures and supporting session rows are scoped to eligible_checkout = 1, without authentication, account or purchase filters.

Every eligible session remains in the performance denominator, including anonymous or unmapped sessions and sessions without orders. Session evidence distinguishes authentication, anonymous identity, source account keys and matched registered account keys; missing links remain unknown, not zero.

Only order.session_key establishes session-to-order association. Session/order evidence may contain several orders per session and must not be used to recalculate or duplicate governed performance measures. Merchandise measures are queried separately at their final order-month/device grain.

Merchandise attribution covers only known explicit eligible-session-to-order links. Campaign and financial cohorts cover only known registered identities from eligible sessions across the two requested months, traversed through reviewed account bridges. Report each cohort's null keys, unmatched mappings and exclusions with original evidence and qualified PARTIAL labels; none is a complete population total.
Recognized service revenue is reported once per selected account-month, before service-month credits, and is not checkout attribution, merchandise booking value or a causal revenue-loss estimate.

Fulfillment and return evidence retains order month and separate ordered_at, fulfilled_at and returned_at clocks. The source device return rate retains its fulfilled-unit denominator. Campaign populations remain campaign/assignment-period scoped and are not summed into unique customer populations.

A June-to-July association is insufficient to establish that a release caused harm. Release assignment, comparable concurrent controls, exposure timing, sample uncertainty, campaign/device composition, fulfillment and return lag, and other concurrent changes require investigation. Randomized offer assignment is not randomized release assignment; missing links or incomplete coverage cannot establish lost orders or lost revenue.

Current-reader metadata acquisition is verified separately from the original author capture. Source freshness, authorization and completeness remain execution gates; the capture timestamp is not a data watermark. Truncation or unqualified partial inputs must not be promoted into qualified cohorts or complete results.

entries.title: Getting started: final Oct 28 source reference

result.question: For July 2026, show each registered customer account's source-owned Active Lines EOM from Subscriptions and Recognized Service Revenue and Contribution Margin from Finance, in cents. Use only these two semantic models. Connect their actual account dimensions through the reviewed shared customer identity and retain one account-month row. Active Lines means the month-end snapshot, not activations or a sum of monthly snapshots. Revenue means recognized service revenue, not billed charges or booked merchandise. Keep accounts with zero or unknown values distinct; never substitute zero for missing or unauthorized data. Explain the source measure ownership and additional customer, period and revenue-meaning context used. Shared execution-format clarification: ResolveConcept, ReadModelSchema and SelectMetric references must be source catalog model IDs, table IDs or metric IDs only. Native entity, Rule and relationship IDs remain planning context but are not allowed values in those no-data operator references. Keep source ownership and interpretation limits in hypotheses. This requirement applies equally to both approaches and supplies no answer, source values or query itinerary.

hypotheses: The population is registered customer accounts, not only accounts with active subscriptions or positive revenue. Accounts are identified by registered account keys; display names are nonunique and are descriptive only.

Subscriptions owns subscriptions.active_lines_eom on subscription_month. Its source grain is subscription_key plus month; the governed measure is requested directly at account-month grain for July 2026. It counts closing active lines, not activations, distinct active accounts, or a sum of snapshots across months.

Finance owns finance.recognized_service_revenue and finance.contribution_margin on account_month, whose source grain is account_key plus service month. Both monetary measures remain in integer cents. Recognized Service Revenue is before service-month credits; Contribution Margin incorporates service-month credits and attributed service cost through the existing Finance calculation. Neither measure is redefined.

July 2026 is selected explicitly as month = 2026-07-01 in both monthly source roles. Subscription month is monthly state and Finance month is service month, not an event or credit-posting month. The answer retains source period columns and one registered-account row for this selected month.

The actual Subscriptions and Finance account dimensions are connected only through bridge_subscriptions_account_finance. Distinct aliases retain each dimension's key lineage for subsequent reviewed dimension-to-fact traversals. Billing keys, display names and coincidentally equal fact keys are not substitutes for this shared identity.

Preserving unmatched registered accounts retains missing observations and unknown mappings rather than excluding them. Explicit source zeros remain zeros; null, missing and unauthorized values never become zero. No positive-value or active-only filter, imputation, ranking or downstream summation is applied.

The additional interpretation context distinguishes registered customers from active lines, monthly state from event flows, and recognized service revenue from billed charges, merchandise bookings and contracted recurring value. Only Subscriptions and Finance are used.

Current-reader native metadata and source-schema acquisition are verified separately from the original author capture. Capture time is not a data watermark; live authorization, freshness, completeness and row-limit gates must succeed before combining artifacts into a complete account-month answer.

Session identity evidence retains all eligible sessions and distinguishes null source account keys from unmatched registered-account mappings. Do not infer anonymous identity resolution without an executable reviewed temporal relationship.

The linked-order table retains the full order-line grain and original booked merchandise cents, booked units, fulfilled units and returned units. These are source observations, not recognized service revenue. Repeated order-header evidence must not be counted as additional orders, and no replacement return-rate formula or financial population total is calculated.

Campaign and Finance queries use only known mapped identities from eligible-session evidence. Report null and unknown mapping exclusions with the original evidence and retain qualified PARTIAL status, coverage and nulls. Neither view is a complete population total.

The Finance cohort is the distinct known mapped accounts observed in eligible sessions across the requested two-month window. Return each selected account's June and July service-month revenue separately; this is account-level context, not checkout attribution.

Campaign evidence is source assignment-month mix for known mapped accounts, separated by campaign, treatment and randomized status. Assignment units are not unique customers or campaign touches, and overlapping campaign populations must not be combined as unique people.

Month-to-month conversion, duration, fulfillment, return or campaign-mix associations are insufficient to establish release-caused harm. A credible release counterfactual, comparable exposure populations, confounder control, valid uncertainty estimates and complete relevant observations are not established by these views. Explicit order linkage is not a lost-revenue estimate, and campaign randomization does not establish randomized release exposure.

metrics.name: Open Cases EOD
metrics.description: Open cases at a specified observed day end. Requires one snapshot_date per result; never sum snapshots over time.

metrics.name: New Cases
metrics.description: Cases by opening month, independent of activity count.

metrics.name: Resolved Cases
metrics.description: Cases resolved by source observation, attributed to opening month.

metrics.name: Repeat Contacts
metrics.description: Subsequent same-reason contacts within seven days for the same account.

metrics.name: Contacted Accounts
metrics.description: Distinct contacted accounts, not the sum of period-level distinct counts.

metrics.name: Escalated Cases
metrics.description: Cases escalated at least once.

metrics.name: First Contact Resolution
metrics.description: First-contact resolutions divided by resolved cases; unresolved cases excluded from denominator.

metrics.name: Mean Resolution Hours
metrics.description: Mean observed duration among resolved cases; unresolved durations remain null.

metrics.name: Booked Units
metrics.description: Booked merchandise units.

metrics.name: Booked Revenue
metrics.description: Booked device revenue, intentionally distinct from finance recognized service revenue.

metrics.name: Fulfilled Units
metrics.description: Units actually fulfilled.

metrics.name: Device Return Rate
metrics.description: Returned units divided by fulfilled units, attributed to order month.

metrics.name: Orders
metrics.description: Placed orders, including subsequent cancellations.

metrics.name: Cancellations
metrics.description: Orders cancelled before fulfilment.

metrics.name: Inventory EOD
metrics.description: Physical units at one observed day end. Requires one snapshot_date per result; never sum snapshots over time.

metrics.name: Stockout Store Days
metrics.description: Store-device-day stockout observations; across devices this is not distinct store days.

metrics.name: Sessions
metrics.description: Observed sessions including anonymous browsing.

metrics.name: Authenticated Sessions
metrics.description: Sessions with resolved authenticated identity.

metrics.name: Eligible Checkout Sessions
metrics.description: Sessions eligible to attempt checkout.

metrics.name: Successful Checkout Sessions
metrics.description: Successful eligible checkouts; not necessarily placed orders.

metrics.name: Checkout Conversion
metrics.description: Successful divided by eligible checkout sessions.

metrics.name: Failed Checkouts
metrics.description: Observed eligible failures; abandonment is not a lost-order assertion.

metrics.name: Digital Active Accounts
metrics.description: Distinct resolved accounts; anonymous/null identities are excluded.

metrics.name: Median Journey Duration
metrics.description: Median of session durations in the requested scope; never average medians.

metrics.name: Applied Credits
metrics.description: Applied credits attributed to SLA service month, with separate posting timestamp.

metrics.name: Contracted Services
metrics.description: Valid contracted service population in one month. Requires one month per result; never sum snapshots over time.

metrics.name: Monitored Service Minutes
metrics.description: Calendar minutes clipped to contract validity.

metrics.name: Breached Services
metrics.description: Service-months exceeding their contract threshold.

metrics.name: SLA Compliance
metrics.description: Compliant contracted service-months divided by contracted service-months.

metrics.name: Contracted Recurring Revenue
metrics.description: Contracted monthly recurring value, not finance recognized revenue.

metrics.name: Eligible Credits
metrics.description: Validity-clipped outage union per service-contract-month; threshold per service, then one monetary cap per contract-month.

metrics.name: Credit Exposure
metrics.description: Eligible less already applied contract-month credits; not a repeated per-incident cap.

metrics.name: Recognized Service Revenue
metrics.description: Recognized service revenue before service-month credits, in integer cents.

metrics.name: Net Recognized Revenue
metrics.description: Recognized service revenue minus service-month credits.

metrics.name: Service Cost
metrics.description: Attributed monthly service cost, not device or offer cost.

metrics.name: Contribution Margin
metrics.description: Net recognized service revenue minus attributed service cost.

metrics.name: Margin Percent
metrics.description: Pooled contribution margin divided by pooled net recognized revenue; never average account percentages.

metrics.name: Revenue per Active Line
metrics.description: Service revenue per closing active line in the same account-month scope; multiple months yield a line-month denominator.

metrics.name: Billed Charges
metrics.description: Signed charges including reversals, grouped by service month; not cash receipts.

metrics.name: Posted Credits
metrics.description: Credit amounts by posting month; service month remains a separate attribute.

metrics.name: Eligible Population
metrics.description: Eligible assignment units; separate campaign populations before interpretation.

metrics.name: Assigned Population
metrics.description: Eligible treatment units actually assigned an offer.

metrics.name: Accepted Offers
metrics.description: Assigned eligible offers accepted.

metrics.name: Acceptance Rate
metrics.description: Accepted divided by assigned offers, not campaign touches.

metrics.name: Offer Cost
metrics.description: Observed accepted-offer cost.

metrics.name: Treatment Retained
metrics.description: Retained eligible randomized assignment units; observational campaign excluded.

metrics.name: Control Retained
metrics.description: Retained eligible randomized assignment units; observational campaign excluded.

metrics.name: Retention Lift
metrics.description: Eligible randomized intention-to-treat retention rate difference; null if either arm is absent. Not an observational causal claim.

metrics.name: Major Incidents
metrics.description: Raw major incident count; overlap is allowed.

metrics.name: Eligible Site Minutes
metrics.description: Monitored site minutes in the bounded telemetry window.

metrics.name: Unavailable Site Minutes
metrics.description: Per-site interval-unioned unavailability, without double-counting overlaps.

metrics.name: Availability Percent
metrics.description: Eligible-minute weighted availability; not the mean of site percentages.

metrics.name: Failed Sessions
metrics.description: Observed failed network sessions, distinct from digital checkout sessions.

metrics.name: Service Degradation Percent
metrics.description: Failed divided by monitored network sessions.

metrics.name: Exposed Lines
metrics.description: Distinct active lines exposed to actual serving-site outages.

metrics.name: Exposure Minutes
metrics.description: Interval-unioned unavailable minutes per exposed line, additive across lines.

metrics.name: Active Lines EOM
metrics.description: Active subscriptions at month end. Requires one month per result; never sum snapshots over time.

metrics.name: Active Accounts EOM
metrics.description: Distinct accounts with active lines in one month; neither account counts nor snapshots can be summed.

metrics.name: Gross Adds
metrics.description: Transitions from inactive to active.

metrics.name: Disconnects
metrics.description: Disconnects from the opening-active cohort.

metrics.name: Net Adds
metrics.description: Gross additions less cohort-qualified disconnects.

metrics.name: Opening Active Lines
metrics.description: Lines active at the start of the month. Requires one month per result; never sum snapshots over time.

metrics.name: Churn Rate
metrics.description: Opening-cohort disconnects divided by opening-active lines; recompute from pooled components.

metrics.name: Average Active Lines
metrics.description: Midpoint of opening and closing line population for a single month. Requires one month per result; never sum snapshots over time.

rules.statement: Preserve observed source coverage and explicit unknowns. Network telemetry covers only observed intervals and cannot establish a complete-month denominator beyond source coverage. Historical Growth eligibility, assignment unit and same-period treatment/control denominators govern recommendations. Use causal language only for an eligible randomized comparison supported by source measures, never observational association. A missing treatment/control arm is undefined, not zero lift. Current consent alone does not recreate historical eligibility, and recommendations never execute outreach, credits or transactions.

Source semantic models own every metric calculation and home table. Finance recognized service revenue, Commerce booked merchandise value and Enterprise contracted recurring value are different meanings; integer cents are minor units. Ratios use source pooled denominators, never averages of percentages. Enterprise source SLA measures own validity-clipped service/contract-month settlement and the contract-period cap; retain signed remaining exposure, credits and nonpositive margins without inventing per-incident financial loss.

Use complete compatible source periods and the full declared source grain. Keep business data, source-model, ontology and context-cache clocks separate. A scalar native key is not a replacement for a composite source grain. Never sum EOD/EOM snapshots across dates, distinct counts across overlapping groups, medians or percentages across batches; use the source-owned measure in the final scope. Missing or partial observations are not measured zero.

Use only registered keys and reviewed conformed identity bridges, not display names or coincidentally equal integers. Billing and anonymous identity mappings and service/site/contract versions require the correct source date role and UTC validity with inclusive starts/exclusive ends; bare partial keys must not imply uniqueness. Serving-site incident overlap, valid mapping and effective contract determine exposure; common geography or a shared account alone is not exposure or session-to-order attribution. Missing/ambiguous mapping remains unknown, not zero impact.
